title: Label: Chablis Premier Cru
scenario: **Domaine Fèvre-Roux** · **CHABLIS PREMIER CRU** · Appellation Chablis Premier Cru Contrôlée · **2019** · 12.5% vol · 750 ml

questions.stem: Which grape is this wine made from?
Where does Premier Cru rank among the four Chablis levels?
questions.explanation: Petit Chablis › Chablis › Premier Cru › Grand Cru, from bottom to top. Grand Cru is only ~3% of Chablis.

questions.stem: Which French region is Chablis part of?
questions.explanation: Bourgogne — its northern outpost, all Chardonnay.

questions.stem: Chablis is typically a sweet wine with low acidity.
questions.explanation: Chablis is generally not sweet, with high acidity and a mineral, flinty note.

questions.stem: Which shellfish does the course pair with Chablis?
questions.explanation: Oysters: Chablis's acidity, body and mineral note match their sweetness, salt and fat.
